hooks.command: test -f obsidian-vault/Home.md && jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("Obsidian vault index (obsidian-vault/Home.md) for this repo — architecture overview:\n\n" + .)}}' obsidian-vault/Home.md 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; if printf '%s' "$f" | grep -Eq '(^|/)(src|web|tools)/' && ! printf '%s' "$f" | grep -Eq '(node_modules|/dist/|/generated/|obsidian-vault)'; then jq -n --arg f "$f" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: ("You just modified " + $f + " — if this changes behavior documented in obsidian-vault/, consider updating the relevant note(s) there.")}}'; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
